start: Android phone, Settings > Rest timer and sounds, 'Workout sounds' on, a workout running

steps.action: Turn off 'Workout sounds'
user_sees: The switch shows off
The 'Rest-over sound' row now reads 'Workout sounds are off: Rest is over only buzzes'
must_not: The default rest or the chosen rest-over sound changes
The switch springs back on

steps.action: Tick a set, lock the phone and wait for the rest to end
user_sees: 'Rest is over' notification with 'Next: <set>' and 'Complete set'
The phone buzzes, the watch buzzes
must_not: Any chime, bell, beep or whistle from the phone
No buzz at all

steps.action: Turn 'Workout sounds' back on and finish the next rest
user_sees: 'Rest is over' rings with the chosen sound again
must_not: The phone keeps buzzing only after the switch is back on
